scope_root.description: Absolute target root used to resolve filesystem spelling of scope paths. Unavailable paths fail mapping validation; legacy ledgers without scope_root must run omgs ledger migrate --run <run-dir> before closing partitions. Migration sets only the target from run-metadata.json after validation. CLI transitions and the critic require scope_root to identify that same filesystem directory before resolution.

evidence.description: What shows the unit was examined: finding fingerprints, candidate files, or repo paths.

note.description: Why the unit was deferred, blocked, or put out of scope. Exclusion units require reviewed, not security relevant: followed by a nonempty reason when out_of_scope.

child_units.description: Bounded partition references. Covered checklists require existing, reconciled children with non-overlapping scope_paths per attack class.

residual_units.description: Required when partial is true and covered. Residuals remain independent accountable units; dangling, duplicate, self and cyclic references fail validation.

path.description: Relative target path. Literal # characters are part of the path.

operation.description: Optional case-sensitive operation identifier, 1 to 128 ASCII characters.

oneOf.description: Legacy plain path with no operation. Strings containing # are ambiguous between a literal path and a path plus operation; use an object with explicit path and optional operation.

scope_paths.description: Bounded source scopes with separate path and optional operation. Omitting operation owns the entire path and descendants. Different operations or attack classes may share a file. Paths must resolve inside scope_root without links.

partial.description: Declare partial examination before closure; preserve unexamined scope in residual_units.

syntax_review.description: Source-only enumeration reviewed completely. Reexports, computed handlers and uncertain syntax require manual mapping or remain blocked.

operations.description: Every HTTP method or native operation mapped to an existing child_units id.

excluded_count.description: Total excluded inventory files in this group.

excluded_paths.description: First 20 excluded inventory paths in sorted order.

excluded_source_count.description: Total excluded files with source or executable extensions in this group.

excluded_source_paths.description: First 20 excluded source paths in sorted order.
